final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS ph, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS a, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS c FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mu FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_kept, SUM(g.c) AS total_stations, AVG(g.a - m.mu) AS avg_excess FROM g, m WHERE g.a > m.mu
